skill_issues_rule: validation issues from 2024-11-01 (before 2025-10-24) whose 7 target days end before the seal
limitations: Publication-lagged replay of a revised historical snapshot (EIA regenerates files daily); real-time vintages are not reconstructed. Envelopes are assumed availability rules (spec §5); the adjusted-demand 2 h envelope is unverified against EIA's imputation timing.
EIA's consumption-basis intensity assigns imports from Canada and Mexico the average US emissions rate (EIA-930 convention).
Skill, model choice and the p10/p90 bands are measured on the validation issues (Nov 2024 to Oct 2025) and assumed to transfer to the issue shown.
Policy S ranks regions by a fixed training mean; it does not read this forecast. The forecast-cleanest region and the cleanest hours are the time-shift view, not S's choice.
The demo issue precedes the validation issues that chose the models and set the bands, but its target days (Nov 1-7, 2024) overlap theirs.
